```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

```{python}
times = np.loadtxt('../src/EdwardsAnderson/time.txt')
```

```{python}
ts = np.linspace(1,8,100)
```

```{python}
plt.scatter(times[:,0], times[0,1]/times[:,1]);
plt.scatter(times[:,0], times[0,2]/times[:,2]);
plt.plot(ts,ts,c='black');
plt.grid();
```

```{python}
time_n = np.loadtxt('../src/EdwardsAnderson/time_n.txt')
```

```{python}
plt.scatter(time_n[:,0]/time_n[0,0],time_n[:,1]/time_n[:,0]*time_n[0,0]/time_n[0,1]);
plt.grid();
```

```{python}
plt.scatter(time_n[:,0]/time_n[0,0],time_n[:,2]/time_n[:,0]*time_n[0,0]/time_n[0,2]);
plt.grid();
```
